##### Project general facts

Binghatti Moonlight is a contemporary residential development located in Al Jaddaf, defined by its sculptural architecture and refined design concept. The tower features a distinctive crystalline façade and a clean, elegant silhouette, enhanced by an illuminated crown that creates a strong visual identity within the skyline. Designed to emphasize light, space, and geometry, the project offers thoughtfully planned apartments with open layouts, generous ceiling heights, and expansive windows, creating a calm and sophisticated living environment.

Residents benefit from a curated selection of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and everyday convenience. The development includes a rooftop infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, landscaped podium areas, and tranquil seating spaces, along with retail outlets and dedicated wellness zones. Pet-friendly areas and integrated office spaces further enhance the lifestyle offering, creating a balanced environment that combines comfort, functionality, and a sense of community.

Interiors are finished with a premium selection of materials, including travertine porcelain, Patagonia marble, brushed brass, tinted mirrors, and oak finishes, complemented by a smart home system for enhanced comfort and control. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, ensuring practicality for daily living. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from high-quality finishes and a refined architectural foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf, situated in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is a dynamic and culturally rich district that seamlessly integrates elements of culture, commerce, and leisure. This area holds cultural significance, boasting a plethora of museums, art galleries, and cultural centers that pay tribute to local and international heritage. Among these, the Dubai Culture Village stands out as a vibrant hub for artistic expression and creative exploration.

With its picturesque location along the Dubai Creek, Al Jaddaf offers stunning waterfront views. It has witnessed significant development, welcoming luxury hotels and contemporary residential complexes that provide captivating vistas of the Dubai Creek.

Al Jaddaf also caters to leisure and recreation, with well-maintained parks and open spaces for residents and visitors to enjoy outdoor activities. The presence of diverse restaurants and cafes adds to its charm, making it a delightful destination for relaxation and dining.
